text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's nothing.
Just a slight headache.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Still, they say 'the good die young' for pretty horse girls too, so I'm starting to get worried..."

Even though Maruzensky put on a cheerful front,
her headache was clearly making things tough for her...
